title: Copper Age
summary: Copper has arrived on the train. Copper gear, spears, and the new Dappled Forest.
description:
Copper has arrived on the train. Copper gear, spears, and the new Dappled Forest.
You'll also find a new series of underwater dimensional carriages, bigger and improved chunk dimensions and a new market carriage. Backpacks now open in workstations, and some performance optimisations (with more to come).

- **Copper gear.** Copper armour, tools and weapons now sit between stone and iron. You'll find them in chests, and your enemies will be wearing them.
- **Spears.** Every tier, from wooden to netherite. They turn up wherever swords do, in chests and in the hands of the things trying to stop you.
- **A longer climb.** With copper in the mix, iron, diamond and netherite gear arrive a little later on the train.
- **A new wood**, with a train stage of its own, plus a host of new blocks to find.

title.zh: 地牢列车 铜器时代更新：铜装备、长矛与全新斑驳森林
title.en: Dungeon Train Copper Age: copper gear, spears and the new Dappled Forest

description.zh: 铜器时代来到了列车上！铜质盔甲、工具和武器现在位于石头与铁之间，你会在箱子里找到它们，敌人也会穿戴它们。长矛覆盖从木到下界合金的每一个等级，凡是会出现剑的地方都会出现长矛。有了铜的加入，铁、钻石和下界合金装备会在列车上稍晚出现。还有一种全新的木材和它专属的列车阶段，以及大量可以发现的新方块。本次更新还带来一系列全新的水下次元车厢、更大更好的区块维度、全新的市场车厢，背包现在可以在工作台中打开，并进行了一些性能优化（更多优化即将到来）。
description.en: Copper has arrived on the train. Copper armour, tools and weapons now sit between stone and iron: you'll find them in chests, and your enemies will be wearing them. Spears come in every tier, from wooden to netherite, and turn up wherever swords do. With copper in the mix, iron, diamond and netherite gear arrive a little later on the train. There's a new wood with a train stage of its own, plus a host of new blocks to find. You'll also find a new series of underwater dimensional carriages, bigger and improved chunk dimensions, a new market carriage, backpacks that open in workstations, and some performance optimisations, with more to come.
